subject: A swing set in hidden-line isometric with a block rider on every seat and chains of slowly different lengths, whose feet strike a tuned bar on the ground as each rider passes the bottom.
controls: length: the chain lengths, riders hanging lower as it rises (position, ~30 px).
count: how many riders hang from the beam (count, 3 to 16).
swing: how far back the riders are held (rotation of each chain about the beam, 10° to 45°).
scale: the lengths of the tuned bars on the ground, longer for lower notes (shape).
muted: Riders sit still at the bottom, feet clear of the bars; the bars go ground grey.
risks: Stretch, and I don't think it earns the exception: the pendulum is already the performer, so a rider adds a character without adding a meaning, and figures invite idle animation and the drawing-quality trap toro hit. The only case for it is warmth: a row of swings reads instantly. A node can't tilt out of the screen's plane, so the swinging riders need pre-drawn poses per angle step, and 16 riders is a crowd.
